data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector founded by Daniel McCann. The company has raised $20M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private companies operating in drones and autonomous systems, including peers such as Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrowly defined stage and sector.

Given data constraints, a single valuation method is applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $20M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $40M. A Peer-Median approach is not applicable here: while 5 same-sector peers exist, the filtered sets (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) contain fewer than the three minimum datapoints required for meaningful comparison. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a median valuation of $40M, with a low estimate of $34M and a high estimate of $46M. The key uncertainty is the absence of proximate peer valuations at identical stage and tier; the range reflects inherent volatility in early-stage valuation absent direct comparables. Investors should weight this range as provisional pending acquisition of additional market transaction data or further company-specific diligence.
